text: A committee of 5 people is to be chosen from 4 men and 6 women. William is one of the 4 men and

and Mary refuse to be on the committee together. [3]

text: The weights of bananas in a fruit shop have a normal distribution with mean 150 grams and standard
deviation 50 grams. Three sizes of banana are sold.
